global_architecture_diagnostics.finding: Java profile stages are runtime-controlled, but dependency order and data passing are encoded in pipeline.py rather than stage contracts.
Spec profile pipeline.stages are descriptive labels; run_spec_analysis executes a fixed normalization pipeline and only reads profile metadata.
Several Java stages consume the whole accumulated AnalysisResult, preventing independent caching and making results depend on profile execution history.

db_schema_scan extracts physical declarations and also launches SQL table observations, mixing base and derived evidence in one stage.
